cause.kind: GPU memory exhaustion during XLA autotuning of the reconstruction diagnostic (recon), not a code exception in the science path and not disk
cause.where: panel.py line 630 at commit 494c3f48: `z, rn, it, reason = host(recon(starts, target, G))` -- the best-found reconstruction diagnostic, vmapped over recon_starts = 8 starts, at q = 256 (K + q = 272 unknowns) on the 1024^2 grid (n = 1 046 529)

RECON q 0 and q 64 had completed; q 256 was next in the built order.
